conclusions: No universal minimum dimension is supported.
L3 is only a bounded B01 state-information lower bound.
L4, L6 and R8 form the retained targeted candidate ladder for cost screening.
R8 is the first tested targeted dimension with six-material placement support, but B05 remains a groundwater-vector tradeoff versus same-partition CoRichards.
Cost is now a separate axis and may not be used to retroactively change the fidelity gate.
